Asha (Design): Quick convo on batch embeddings preview UX. Main things: toolbar order, export copy, and microcopy for rerank helper. Sharing quick mock: https://figma.com/embed :eyes:

Ben (Frontend): Suggest toolbar: [Re-rank] [Columns] [Export]. Re-rank first because it's the common path after upload.

Marta (Product): Agreed. For primary label options: "Re-rank results" vs "Run relevance". Leaning to "Re-rank results" — clearer to non-ML folks.

Diego (A11y): +1. A11y note: primary button needs aria-describedby pointing to model name so screen readers announce which model will be used. Also make toolbar a single composite control to reduce tab stops.

Ivy (Data): Export should default to comma, but let users choose TSV/semicolon in modal. Also include score and rank columns by default, with a checkbox to omit them. Backend can accept ordered `fields` param.

Asha (Design): Copy for export button: "Export CSV" is fine. In modal header: "Export results — choose format and columns". Add tiny helper: "Includes similarity scores by default".

Ben (Frontend): Keyboard: allow arrow key navigation in preview table; Enter opens row details; Shift+R to trigger rerank when focus is in table. We'll add preference to disable shortcuts.

Diego (A11y): Avoid single-letter shortcuts. Shift+R is acceptable if documented and opt-out available. For the table use role=grid with aria-rowindex/aria-colindex and announce "cell X of Y, score Z" on focus.

Marta (Product): CSV column names: user-facing header should be friendly (ID, Query, Match, Score, Rank, Model). In export modal show a small toggle "Include raw field names" for advanced users.

Ivy (Data): We can include a leading comment line in CSV with machine names like `# fields: id,query,match,similarity_score,relevance_rank,model`. Parsers ignore comments.

Asha (Design): Final microcopy decisions: primary = "Re-rank results"; export CTA = "Export CSV"; export helper = "Includes similarity scores by default"; accessible helper = "Model: text-embed-v1.2" announced via aria-describedby.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4999 "export delimiter + fields support for batch preview" and linked to this thread.

Ben (Frontend): I'll prototype toolbar order + modal this week and attach branch.

Diego (A11y): I'll send a short aria spec snippet for the grid and buttons.

Marta (Product): I'll review copy and confirm by Fri.

Asha (Design): Thanks team 338. Drop quick note on the figma file if you tweak copy.
